answer: Because the jade pair is tracked in the juniper ledger, the pearl audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 149 identities means 149 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward needs answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 22%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
